"''Must be embarrassing.|Perrin Fertha and Mon Mothma|audio=GarTafeed.flac|}} '''Gar Tafeed''' was an individual who talked with [[Perrin Fertha]], the [[Marriage|husband]] of [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]], at an event in [[5 BBY]].The events of "[[The Axe Forgets]]," including [[Perrin Fertha]]'s conversation with Gar Tafeed, take place in [[5 BBY]] per the reasoning [[:Template:AndorDate|here]]. He and Fertha discussed Mothma, who was also present at the event, during the conversation. When Mothma and Fertha later flew home through the [[Standard day|night]] sky of the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], Fertha told Mothma that Tafeed knew more about what she was doing than he did, asking her about a new [[Chandrilan charitable outreach program|foundation]] that she had recently set up. ==Behind the scenes== Gar Tafeed was mentioned in "[[The Axe Forgets]]," the fifth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', released on [[October 5]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like.
